_comment: Pokemon character presets for PokemonPromptBuilder. Add any Pokemon here.
_format: Each key is the lowercased Pokemon name. Colours, body, features are used in prompts.

pikachu.colours: bright yellow body with brown stripes on its back and red circular cheek pouches
pikachu.body: small chubby mouse-like body with very large pointy ears tipped with black
pikachu.features: distinctive lightning bolt-shaped yellow and brown tail, small round black eyes, stubby arms

charizard.colours: orange body with cream-white underside, teal-blue wing membranes
charizard.body: large bipedal fire-breathing dragon with broad wings and muscular build
charizard.features: flame burning at tail tip, two cream-coloured horns, sharp claws, long neck

bulbasaur.colours: blue-green teal body with dark teal spots, red eyes
bulbasaur.body: small quadruped dinosaur-like creature with a large green plant bulb on its back
bulbasaur.features: bulb with visible thick veins on its back, stubby legs, short wide snout

squirtle.colours: light blue body with pale yellow front plastron, brown shell with a spiral ridge pattern
squirtle.body: small bipedal turtle with a rounded shell on its back and stubby arms
squirtle.features: curly swirl-shaped tail, large round eyes, small ears, segmented brown shell

charmander.colours: orange body with cream-white belly, red-orange flame at tail tip
charmander.body: small bipedal lizard-like dinosaur with a long tail ending in a flame
charmander.features: always-burning tail flame, large expressive eyes, small claws, cream underbelly

mewtwo.colours: pale lavender-grey body with purple details, large intense purple eyes
mewtwo.body: tall bipedal humanoid with a very large head, slender body, and long thick tail
mewtwo.features: tube connecting from neck to back of skull, defined muscle lines, three-fingered hands

gengar.colours: deep purple body with lighter purple round belly, small red glowing eyes
gengar.body: round wide-bodied ghost-type with a wide jagged grinning mouth full of teeth
gengar.features: spiky back protrusions, stubby arms with three claws, pointed ears, shadowy undefined form

eevee.colours: warm light brown fur, cream-white fluffy collar ruff and bushy tail tip
eevee.body: small fox-like quadruped with oversized pointy ears and large soulful brown eyes
eevee.features: fluffy cream bushy tail, small dainty paws, tuft on forehead, cute round face

snorlax.colours: teal-green body with cream-white round belly, tiny dark beady eyes
snorlax.body: enormous rotund bear-like creature, extremely round large belly dominates the form
snorlax.features: tiny hands and feet relative to enormous body, ears folded back, perpetually drowsy expression

lucario.colours: blue and black body with yellow chest spike, red eyes
lucario.body: tall bipedal jackal-like with dreadlock-style appendages from the back of its head
lucario.features: yellow spike on chest, blue-tipped black appendages on head, blue and black thighs, aura-user

umbreon.colours: sleek black body with glowing yellow ring markings on ears, tail, forehead, and body
umbreon.body: medium cat-like quadruped with long pointy ears, lithe muscular body, long tail
umbreon.features: circular glowing yellow ring bands on all body segments, glowing red eyes, smooth sleek form

gyarados.colours: deep blue serpentine body with white underbelly, yellow whiskers, red eyes
gyarados.body: enormous sea serpent with a massive jaw, fins, and hundreds of scales
gyarados.features: large fanged open jaw, head fins, barbels extending from mouth, coiling serpentine body

dragonite.colours: orange body with cream-white underbelly, small cream-coloured wings relative to body
dragonite.body: large rotund friendly-looking dragon, bipedal with small wings and a round pudgy body
dragonite.features: antenna-like horns, surprisingly small wings for its body size, friendly round face

blastoise.colours: blue body with pale yellow front shell, brown shell with two large water cannons
blastoise.body: large bipedal turtle with an enormous thick shell featuring two mechanical water cannons
blastoise.features: two large retractable cannon barrels on shell, small tail, determined expression

meowth.colours: cream-coloured body with brown tail tip, gold coin on forehead
meowth.body: small bipedal cat-like creature with a coin on its head and a curled tail
meowth.features: gold yen coin on forehead, large round eyes, small paws, curling coin-tip tail
